executive_summary: Maven build failed due to a method signature mismatch in TaskManagementController. The controller calls getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects two separate int parameters for pagination. This requires updating either the interface to accept Pageable or the controller to extract page/size from Pageable.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied: required Long,int,int but found Long,Pageable
errors.root_cause: Method signature mismatch between TaskManagementController and TaskService interface. The controller passes a Pageable object to getUserTasks(), but the interface method signature expects (Long userId, int page, int size) instead of (Long userId, Pageable pageable).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature to accept Pageable parameter: change from 'getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size)' to 'getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable)'. Then update the implementation class to extract page and size from the Pageable object using pageable.getPageNumber() and pageable.getPageSize().
